verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph (which underlies OneDrive) provides documented change notifications (webhooks) that alert applications when a resource like a driveItem is created, updated, or deleted, directly enabling webhook-based subscriptions for AI-native integrations. Delta query is also documented as a complementary polling-based alternative for change tracking. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability or latency, and no explicit OneDrive-specific (vs generic Graph) webhook setup walkthrough in the evidence.
